title: NMM Log In Fail
body: Every time I try to log into my Nexus account on the mod manager it says I cannot reach the Nexus Metadata Servers. I have uninstalled the manager reinstalled it, opened it in administrative, blocked on my firewall and unblocked it, I've opened it up while I was logged into the Nexus site and still nothing. I have no Idea what to do can anyone help me with this??
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body:
There could be two parts to this:
1. If your NMM is below version 0.65.2 you won't be able to access the Nexus servers due to a GDPR-related update.
2. You cannot use your email address as a username when logging in to NMM, you need to use your Nexus username.

Grab [NMM 0.65.9](https://github.com/Nexus-Mods/Nexus-Mod-Manager/releases/tag/0.65.9), and you should have no issues logging in.
